swot.text: Strong rural consumer baseline in Ratwara Bindwara Deoria (Population: 22,386).
No village-level establishment breakdown available (558 firms in Aurai).
90% concessional financing under NSFDC reduces initial capital requirement.
Regional raw material and transport price fluctuations during monsoon.

pricing_guidance.text: Estimated monthly revenue for a small-scale Dairy micro-enterprise in Aurai block is ~₹32,000 based on regional demand.
